name: Trajectory Recovery
description: A new evaluation setting and benchmark where models must recover person trajectories across cameras, testing temporal and cross-view association performance.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (IDF1 / MOTA / association accuracy and ID switch counts commonly reported)
general_score_metric: IDF1 (commonly used primary metric for association quality)
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark targeting cross-camera trajectory recovery; adoption is currently limited but relevant for surveillance and multi-camera tracking research.
notes: Uses person trajectory data—raises privacy/ethical considerations; dataset sizes and camera setups may be limited, and there is risk of overlap with training data for preexisting re-ID models.
